brief: A dark surface serves as an ice rink where elegant, sweeping white lines glide in graceful, continuous curves. As these lines travel, they transform into distinct, glowing white pillars that rise vertically from the surface. These luminous pillars remain visible after they are formed, slowly accumulating into a complex, three-dimensional sculpture of light.
